markdown: ## TL;DR The task asked for a QA sweep of the Activity and Insights pages. The UI has no Insights page, so the sweep covered the Control dashboard (`/`), which the mobile More sheet labels "Activity", and its live activity feed. The headless walk at 375, 768 and 1280 px found no overflow, page errors or missing focus rings. It did find two real bugs in the feed's data path, and both are fixed with tests: free text was injected into feed HTML unescaped, and seven server event types had store handlers but were never subscribed, so those branches were dead code. ## Work and rationale **Scope.** I searched the UI source, router, nav and docs for "insights" and found nothing. "Activity" appears only as the mobile More-sheet label for the dashboard. Earlier QA notes (`docs/qa/2026-11-control-dashboard.md`, `2026-11-stats-dev-pages-qa.md`) already covered the dashboard's resource and usage panels. I therefore treated the feed as the activity surface that still needed walking, and I say so in the task notes rather than inventing an Insights page. **Walk.** I built the UI with `bun run build:ui` and served `dist/ui` from a scratch Bun server outside the repo. Playwright ran WebKit headless and fixtured every `/api/*` call: auth signed in, `/api/events` aborted, the rest 503. At each width I measured document width against the viewport, collected elements that overflowed outside their own scroll box, recorded page errors, and checked each focusable control for a focus ring. Overflow, page errors and focus were all clean. The 375 px screenshot showed a failed-request toast over the page title, which I left alone because toasts float by design. **Feed escaping.** `repo.ts` already has `escapeHtml` for feed entries, but eight `pushFeed` call sites interpolated raw event fields into the `v-html` message. The worst was `task.created`, which put the task title in unescaped, so a title containing markup would render as HTML. Others were run labels, self-heal notes, auto-approve rules, preview URLs, review errors and the generic error message. I escaped each one. I also changed `escapeHtml` to accept `unknown` and coerce missing values to an empty string. Without that, a partial SSE payload would now throw inside the event handler, where before it rendered as the text "undefined". **Dead subscriptions.** The EventSource subscribes to a fixed list of event names. The approval-policy commit (`0686`) added a `task.autoApproved` branch without adding it to that list, and seven types with branches were missing. The server does emit them, so the branches could never run. I added `task.autoApproved`, `task.debugTldr`, `task.doneErrorTldr`, `agent.queued`, `agent.dequeued`, `auto-engineering.state` and `bookkeeping.recovered`. I left out `board.alert`, `release.notesRun` and `supervisor.heartbeat`, which have no store handler. **Tests.** In `src/ui-app/tests/repo-store.test.ts` I added two table-driven blocks. The first feeds an `` payload through each changed branch and asserts the output contains the escaped form and no raw tag. The second asserts that each newly subscribed name is registered on the fake EventSource. Before the subscription fix, the auto-approve escape case failed with `feed[0]` undefined, which is how I found the dead subscription. **Docs.** I wrote `docs/qa/2026-11-activity-qa.md` with scope, method, results, fixes and the one item left alone, following the pattern of earlier QA notes. **Not done.** I did not declare shots. The feed fix changes escaping and subscriptions, not layout, so there is no visible difference for a reviewer to see on a fixture. I also did not walk the Agents last-run view or any other page; if "Insights" means a specific page, the task needs that named. ## Approaches tried - Searching for an Insights route first, which found nothing, before deciding how to read the task. - Running the walk in Playwright with `page.route` fixtures against the built app, rather than mounting components in jsdom. The built app catches real boot, nav and layout behaviour that component tests miss. - Driving keyboard focus with Tab. In headless WebKit, Tab never left `BODY`, so I switched to focusing each control directly and reading its computed ring. That checks for a ring but not the Tab order itself. - Checking the subscription gap by diffing the server's emitted event types (`src/server/live-index.ts`) against the store's subscription array, which produced the exact list of dead names. ## Challenges and blockers - `vitest` run directly skipped the jsdom environment, so `window` was undefined and 67 tests failed. Running through `bun run test` fixed it. This is a usage note, not a code problem. - My first background `build:ui` produced no output and no `dist/ui`. The shell call ended and killed it, so I reran it in the foreground. - The `vue-tsc` run reports 112 type errors in unrelated test files such as `task-card-1040-blurb-popover.test.ts`. None are in the files I changed. I did not fix them because they predate this branch and are outside the task. - I was not permitted to start `repoos serve`, so I could not walk the real server. The fixture walk stands in for it, and the fixtures return 503 for everything except auth, so populated-feed states were not exercised in the browser. ## Key learnings - A handler that is not subscribed is invisible. When a server event type gains a store branch, the subscription list has to change in the same commit. The diff between `live-index.ts` event types and the subscription array is a cheap check to run whenever either side changes; a test now guards the seven names. - `v-html` feed messages are a standing injection surface. Any new `pushFeed` call must escape free text, and the escape test is the place to add the next hostile payload. - Naming matters for QA scope. "Insights" existed only in a task title, so the walk should start by confirming that a named page exists before planning fixtures. ## Generated change summary Base tree: `986e3246270a6810b5810d4510f96f73e226ca0b` Source tree: `5c26a2146acafa7d3cd32e60df4a79b9f748b506` - A docs/qa/2026-11-activity-qa.md: +32 / −0 - M src/ui-app/src/stores/repo.ts: +42 / −11 - M src/ui-app/tests/repo-store.test.ts: +68 / −0
